mathematical_proofs.name: EXIF_Orientation_and_JXFORM_Dihedral_D4_Mapping
mathematical_proofs.proof: In getRotationTypeFromExifOrientation (0x0034dc..0x003508), sub w8, w1, #1; cmp w8, #7 checks exif_orientation in [1, 8] and loads w0 = kExifOrientationToRotationType_0x037c00[w8]. In rotateJpeg (0x00288c..0x002894), sub x8, x22, #1 indexes kRotationTypeToJxformCode_0x037b28[rotation_type - 1] to select the exact IJG transupp JXFORM_CODE in the 8-element dihedral group D_4.

mathematical_proofs.name: Lossless_8x8_DCT_Frequency_Domain_Dihedral_Transformations
mathematical_proofs.address_range: 0x01984c..0x01ab28 (do_flip_h, do_flip_v, do_transpose, do_rot_90, do_rot_270, do_rot_180, do_transverse)
mathematical_proofs.formula: C'_{u,v} = (-1)^p * C_{pi(u,v)} where horizontal flip negates odd horizontal frequencies v (v mod 2 == 1) and vertical flip negates odd vertical frequencies u (u mod 2 == 1)
mathematical_proofs.proof: Because the 1D DCT-II basis functions satisfy cos((2x+1)*k*pi/16) = (-1)^k * cos((2(7-x)+1)*k*pi/16), reversing spatial coordinates x -> 7-x in an 8x8 block is equivalent to multiplying every odd-indexed frequency coefficient k in {1,3,5,7} by -1 without inverse/forward DCT quantization loss. Verified R_90^4 = I, R_90^2 = R_180, R_90^3 = R_270, and F_H^2 = F_V^2 = T^2 = V^2 = I.

mathematical_proofs.name: IJG_Quality_to_Linear_Quantization_Scale_Factor
mathematical_proofs.proof: At 0x007ae4..0x007b20, w1 is clamped to [1, 100] via cmp w1, #1; csinv w8, w1, wzr, gt and cmp w1, #0x64; csel w9, w8, w9, lt. Then mov w8, #0x1388 (5000); sdiv w8, w8, w9 computes 5000/q, mov w10, #0xc8 (200); sub w9, w10, w9, lsl #1 computes 200 - 2*q, and cmp w1, #0x32 (50); csel w1, w8, w9, lt selects between them before calling jpeg_add_quant_table (0x0079c4) on Annex K luma (0x037d60) and chroma (0x037e60) tables.
